name: money firewall / prohibited framing

false_positives.detail: Slide 2 text 'It contains no projections, no recommendations, and no calls to action' matched the words 'projections'/'recommendations' — the deck's own money-firewall disclaimer, not a violation.

Dollar figures appear only inside quoted creator itinerary titles from pilot.db ('How to Visit 15 European Cities for less than $350/£300', '5-day Scotland itinerary (under $1,000)', 'How far does $100 get you in Lombok') — factual reporting of collected titles, not report economics.

'Ireland scenic-drive guides + recommendations map' and 'Taiwan travel recommendations (Nataly & Murad Osmann)' are creator content titles about travel tips, not business recommendations by the report.

note: Deterministic scan of all 50 deck slides and every workbook cell. No report-authored dollar figures, projections, recommendations, CTAs, sales language, or commercial framing. Economics remain parked per the money firewall.
